text: Ɓe mbii (yahud en e nasaara en): Alla jogitiima ɓiɗɗo! senaande woodani Mo, Kanko Mbo yondinii gaa tagoore Makko, jogittooɗo ɓiɗɗo ko hatojinɗo heen, accu dey Kanko Mo senaande woodani jeyi kala ko woni e asamaanji e lesdi, tagooje ɗee fof ko jeyal Makko, ko ɗoftaniiɗe Mo, Ombo firlita ɗe no O muuyiri.
